screen.monoplegia.title: Monoplegia
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.monoplegi: Allow or block ordinary torch and lantern placement from your offhand. Switch modes with a hotkey. Useful with dynamic lighting.
option.monoplegia.allowed.description: Ordinary torches and lanterns can be placed from your offhand.
option.monoplegia.blocked.description: Offhand placement is blocked. Items remain held for dynamic lighting.
option.monoplegia.chat.description: Notifications appear in chat and remain in chat history.
